reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Physical-lesion tracking, mapped cell-cycle transition and acute RAD9 dependence; synthesis inhibition is an additional initiation/maintenance branch.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-experiment consultation/check of original Methods, supplements or validated protocols to select and transfer detailed conditions; establishing local prerequisites alone is insufficient.

The central repair/conditional-switch/damage-assay technologies and operating conditions remain unspecified without a concrete tool-selection and quantitative calibration-to-execution procedure. Qualitative validation gates do not make the proposed main intervention directly executable.

checks.quote: below a pre-set floor
checks.reason: The synthesis pilot has proposed 90% suppression/80% viability gates, but does not define uptake/background normalization and incorporation detection limits. Physical lesion loading controls likewise lack quantitative range/reference acceptance and failure calibration.

checks.quote: Hierarchical tests, in order
checks.reason: The hierarchy is useful but no exact clustered time-to-event/median estimator, competing-death implementation or family-wise decision procedure is fixed. Mentioning sensitivity to lysed cells does not define how their outcome enters the model.

Dose/duration/switch parameters are described as a range or to be calibrated without a bounded ladder or a concrete range-derivation and acceptance-to-lock procedure. This differs from independent assay calibration in P03.

checks.quote: The next action is assay or allele improvement
checks.reason: Pilot/main separation and no interim efficacy stopping are good, but assay/allele improvements lack an explicit revised-method freeze and fresh independent confirmation requirement.

checks.quote: New protein synthesis is required to establish the delay
checks.reason: A translation block can alter general cell-cycle competence or deplete a short-lived permissive factor; loss of a division delay does not uniquely establish new checkpoint synthesis. The packet-phenotype gate also wrongly requires a wrong-transition external block never permit repair. These are independent decision flaws within the single P13 deduction.

checks.quote: measurement file is locked
checks.reason: Coded cultures, measurement lock and delivery records are specified, but raw imaging/lesion identifiers, exact analysis versions/settings and complete source-to-output traceability are not supplied.

checks.quote: Do not treat survival as repair.
checks.reason: A valuable alternative coupling question includes synthesis as one secondary branch. Genetic complement/backcross, sham, solvent, undamaged shifts, reciprocal marks and two processing blocks are prospective controls. Physical lesions and population limits are distinguished; 4,210 words and proposed-status labeling meet format.

explanation_reason: Strong alternative mechanism controls and cohort accounting. The synthesis branch lacks the timing/readouts needed for the historical experiment and overinterprets inhibitor failure; several operational/audit choices remain unresolved.
historical_match_reason: The secondary synthesis-versus-existing-protein question and mechanism are explicitly present. However, the establishment inhibitor starts immediately AFTER irradiation without verifying suppression before checkpoint induction; the post-arrest arm is explicitly not the main off-switch test. There is no separately verified checkpoint recovery during ongoing synthesis inhibition and the inhibitor decision ignores general cell-cycle/short-lived-factor effects. The intervention/readout/qualified prediction therefore fail; merely mentioning synthesis is not a full historical hit.
